name: InnMind

sources.title: InnMind homepage — Web3/AI startup fundraising platform with free startup profiles

requirements: Startup profile platform oriented to Web3, crypto and AI fundraising — strongest fit for those sectors
Free tier: create a startup profile, be discoverable to investors, access free templates and perks
Core and Pro paid plans add expanded investor discovery, outreach workflow, priority support (prices shown on /pricing)
preparation: Investor-ready profile content: market, traction, team, round details, roadmap, token model if relevant
Pitch deck and financial materials to attach (their templates: pitch deck, SAFE + token warrant, tokenomics)
workflow: Sign up and choose the free plan
Create the startup profile — market, traction, team, round details
Publish so the profile is discoverable to InnMind's VC/angel user base (36K+ registered startup profiles claimed)
Optionally upgrade to Core/Pro for deeper investor discovery and outreach tools
watchFor: This is a fundraising platform, not a launch board — 'live' means your profile is discoverable to investors, not a public directory page with a link
Heavy upsell surface: templates, investor databases, Premium membership
Web3/AI tilt — a generic SaaS may see limited investor relevance
Investor 'Verified' badge exists for profiles confirmed through their manual process
countsAsLive: The startup profile is published on innmind.com and discoverable to registered investors
unknowns: Whether the public web exposes a crawlable profile page/URL with an outbound link
Core/Pro pricing specifics (page referenced but amounts not captured)
Whether any profile data becomes public vs investor-only
Whether profiles get an outbound dofollow link
